assumption: Stations without a defensible one-to-one identity are represented by the explicit and ESPENI-derived aggregate onshore-wind fleet.
Residual stations are represented by the model offshore-wind fleet; identity remains unresolved.
Demonstration turbines are represented within the model offshore-wind fleet.
Floating demonstration output is represented within the model offshore-wind fleet.
Small and differently named accredited PV stations are represented by explicit REPD solar plus the ESPENI embedded-solar residual.

ofgem_technology: Hydro with a DNC greater than 20 MW
assumption: Residual hydro stations are represented by the combined model hydro fleet.

ofgem_technology: Hydro with a DNC of 20MW or less
assumption: Small legacy hydro omitted or differently named in REPD is represented by the combined model hydro fleet.
Micro-hydro accreditations are represented by the model hydro aggregate.
Residual fuelled stations are represented by the dispatchable renewable-fuel aggregate; technology detail is retained in the official ledger.

ofgem_technology: Fuelled with a DNC of 50kW or less
assumption: Sub-50kW fuelled stations are represented within the dispatchable renewable-fuel aggregate.
Small or renamed landfill-gas stations are represented by the model landfill-gas fleet.
Small or renamed sewage-gas stations are represented by the model sewage-gas fleet.
Residual tidal accreditations are represented by the model tidal-stream fleet.
